task: Wikimedia visual-source audit for ancient Arles / ca.314
accessLimitation: Commons file pages and exact licenses were read. Direct upload.wikimedia.org originals were repeatedly rate-limited (HTTP 429). Full-resolution pixel dimensions were retrieved via i0.wp.com proxy; byte count differs from Wikimedia original metadata, so these are not represented as byte-identical originals.

assets.author: Larry (Flickr user microbe; page credits Larry from Charlottetown)
assets.whatItShows: Current archaeological remains of the Gallo-Roman theatre at Arles.
assets.limits: Present-day conservation and urban surroundings, not an intact 314 CE view; no claim about the theatre’s exact use/state in 314. Commons file page also records reviewed Flickr licensing.
assets.read: Commons file page: original dimensions/file size, author/date, CC BY 2.0 terms; downloaded full-dimension copy from image CDN because upload.wikimedia.org returned 429.

assets.author: Stefan Bauer (Ferras)
assets.whatItShows: Present-day Arles amphitheatre, also catalogued by French heritage database Mérimée PA00081119.
assets.limits: Modern remains, repairs and present-day appearance; the ancient arena’s later residential/fortified phases mean it cannot stand for a pristine fourth-century amphitheatre. Image is only 990×645 pixels. Derivative/adapted distribution subject to share-alike.
